description: Generate a ready-to-commit message from staged or working-tree changes, with local grouping and optional LLM wording.
config.title: Commit Helper
config.provider.desc: LLM provider. API keys are stored in SecretStorage, not in settings.
config.provider.local: Deterministic local grouping only; no network access
config.baseUrl.desc: Base URL for the selected provider. Example: https://api.openai.com/v1
config.model.desc: Model name, for example gpt-4o-mini, deepseek-chat, claude-3-5-sonnet-latest or gemini-2.0-flash.
config.language.desc: Language of the generated message. Auto follows recent commit messages.
config.scope.desc: Which changes to read when generating.
config.scope.auto: Use staged changes when present, otherwise working-tree changes
config.scope.all: All tracked changes (staged and unstaged) plus untracked files
config.confirm.desc: Ask before sending the diff to the configured provider.
config.includeDiff.desc: Send the unified diff. Disable to send only the file list.
config.maxDiffChars.desc: Maximum diff characters sent to the model; longer diffs are truncated.
config.maxTokens.desc: Maximum output tokens for the model response.
config.formatTemplate.desc: Layout of the final message. Supports {subject}, {items}, {issue} and {skeleton}.
config.itemLine.desc: How each item is rendered. Supports {type}, {scope}, {scopeRaw} and {text}.
config.prompt.desc: Prompt template. Supports {language}, {format}, {diff}, {fileList}, {types} and {extraContext}; omitted diff/fileList blocks are appended automatically.
